brief:
The Gaza Ministry of National Economy categorically denied allegations circulating against engineer Abd al-Fattah Abu Musa regarding the collection of money, price increases, trading in aid, coordination arrangements, and real estate ownership, Shehab Wire reported. The ministry did not address specific details of the accusations.

The ministry said it would pursue legal action against those responsible for what it characterized as defamation.
